text: Report 02:55. Aircraft PH-HZE, cabin ready 10 min early.
Slot delay 25 min out of AMS, ATC flow into Naples.
Pax in 12C unwell on descent; met by handling on arrival.
Quick turn in NAP, 45 min. Catering short by two crew meals.
First sector with the new purser checklist.
Overhead bin latch row 8 sticking — written up in the CDL.
Smooth return, on blocks 6 min early.
Full flight, 189 pax. Boarding via two doors.
Crew bus left EIN on time at 02:20.
Traffic clear, arrived AMS 03:40 as planned.
Note from a roster year that was never imported.
